name: Consecutive Commodities Limited
about: Consecutive Commodities Limited primarily invests in, acquires, deals in, holds, and disposes shares, stocks, debentures, bonds, and other securities in India. The company engages in agri trading business. The company was formerly known as Consecutive Investments & Trading Company Limited and changed its name to Consecutive Commodities Limited in December 2025. Consecutive Investments & Trading Company Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
